user_prompt: ты - эксперт ЕГЭ, проверь мое решение и поставь балл
input_note: Same task-and-answer images as the historical run; Kostyan task images also contain a reference solution. Expert scores/verdicts, old responses, and BotAI prompts are excluded.
transport: Fresh ephemeral Codex CLI sessions authenticated with ChatGPT. This is not a run through the ChatGPT website. Common neutral system instruction; tools disabled; no BotAI pipeline; no score rubric supplied.
score_metric: Exact agreement with the saved expert score on 39 mathematical image cases. Missing or ambiguous scores, failures and unexpected rejections are not matches.
joint_metric: Score match AND correct identification of the main material error with recognizable location and mathematically valid explanation/correction. Correct solutions must be accepted without invented material errors. Minor slips that do not change diagnosis/correction do not invalidate. A generic advice sentence is insufficient.
rejection_metric: K-M2 is excluded from both numeric score metrics and checked separately.
aggregation: Pool all 39 cases. Do not average dataset percentages; retain historical weight of alternative photos.
human_review_note: Explanation quality is an agent review against hidden expert comments and original images when needed, not a fresh official expert label.
